rules.statement: A person claiming to be the owner of an undivided share of land and entitled to possession thereof is competent to maintain an action for partition, even if neither he nor his predecessor in title has had possession and the defendants wholly deny his title.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where such an action is brought in good faith, its failure ought not to render the plaintiff liable to be cast in double costs under section 4 of the Ordinance No. 10 of 1897."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 4 of the Ordinance No. 10 of 1897
